# raccoon-herder user book

Generated HTML for the Raccoon Herder operator/user book.

**Do not edit these files by hand.** Source markdown is `site/` in the private
[raccoon-herder](https://github.com/shikkie/raccoon-herder) app repo. Rebuild
and publish from there:

```bash
scripts/build-pages.sh
scripts/push-docs.sh
```

`index.html` is the book. GitHub Pages is **not** enabled yet (the app repo
is private; this docs repo can host Pages later from `main` / **root**).
